g.text: POST /api/ai-agents-teams/{address}/{id}/unpublish — stop a published team answering mentions
or a legacy publication without did/handle]
This mutation sits OUTSIDE the two-phase signing
protocol: the HTTP call is unauthenticated, and
the PDS mutation is performed with credentials
only the Embers service holds. The account and
handle are kept — republishing reverses it.
The on-chain credential stack exposes only push
and toList: a publication is permanent history.
What varies is the config record's presence,
which is exactly what published-state reports
